thought.text: Das ist ein fundamentales Architekturproblem! Ich muss eine Factory erstellen die alle Dependencies erstellt:

reasoning_content:
I see the issue now - WorldTick requires ALL these parameters in constructor but the ServerBootstrap only passes `ws`. This is a broken architecture. Looking at lines 335+ - some parameters like `liveHeal`, `areStateCompiler`, `glbRegistry`, etc. have defaults. But most don't.

The proper solution is to modify the ServerBootstrap to create all these dependencies and pass them to WorldTick. OR create a factory that does this. Let me create that factory.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("=== 5. CREATE WORLDTICK FACTORY ===")

# First check what imports exist at top of WorldTick
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -80 /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts | tail -40")
print("Imports:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
